posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
So I was in the "Learn how to play Sentinels of the Multiverse" Twitch thing earlier (it was fun), and of course I was listening out for any interesting little nuggets of info that I could glean from our favourite Christopher. Admittedly I may have missed some things because I was both chatting and watching an interesting Omnitron game as well as listening to the strategy discussion that was going on, but here is something I can remember.

After telling us that Haka is one of the most intelligent heroes, I expressed disbelief that he could be more intelligent than Tachyon. Christopher said that sure, Tachyon's more intelligent, but Haka's more wise (to use D&D terminology). Then,"The Scholar and Haka are similarly wise, but The Scholar has a few notable lapses in judgement in his past."

[Christopher, can I tell people about what you said in response to Jeremy talking about gaming with his kids? Thought I should check.]
